title: QUTCC: Quantile Uncertainty Training and Conformal Calibration for Imaging Inverse Problems
abstract: arXiv:2507.14760v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While deep learning offers tremendous promise for scientific and medical imaging, any failures and hallucinations (predictions that do not coincide with reality) are hard to pinpoint and can have serious downstream consequences. Uncertainty estimation techniques, such as conformal prediction, can help by predicting statistically valid error bars for a model's prediction. However, popular conformal prediction methods were not designed for high-dimensional image-valued problems and do not take into account spatial correlations within an image during conformal calibration, resulting in larger-than-necessary uncertainty intervals. We propose a practical simultaneous quantile regression method that enables non-linear, spatially-adaptive scaling during conformal calibration. translated_title: QUTCC：面向成像逆问题的分位数不确定性训练与共形校准
translated_abstract: 尽管深度学习为科学和医学成像带来了巨大的前景，但模型的失败与幻觉（与现实不符的预测）难以精确定位，并可能造成严重的下游后果。诸如共形预测之类的不确定性估计技术可以通过为模型预测提供统计上有效的误差棒来缓解这一问题。然而，主流的共形预测方法并非针对高维图像类问题而设计，且在共形校准过程中未考虑图像内部的空间相关性，导致不确定性区间过于宽泛。我们提出了一种实用的同时分位数回归方法，能够在共形校准过程中实现非线性、空间自适应的缩放。我们的方法 QUTCC 使用带有分位数嵌入的 U-Net 架构，在训练阶段学习完整的条件分位数分布，随后利用该……
tldr: 提出QUTCC方法，利用带分位数嵌入的U-Net进行同时分位数回归训练，并在共形校准中引入非线性、空间自适应缩放，从而为成像逆问题生成更紧凑且统计有效的不确定性区间。
en_tdlr: QUTCC trains a U-Net with quantile embeddings for simultaneous quantile regression and applies conformal calibration with non-linear, spatially-adaptive scaling, yielding tighter, statistically valid uncertainty intervals for imaging inverse problems.
